item.title: Another court blocks White House ballroom work, teeing up a Supreme Court review
item.description: A federal appeals court says above-ground construction cannot continue without approval from Congress, siding with historic preservation advocates.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Monty Roberts, who trained horses through trust, dies at 91
item.description: The internationally acclaimed horseman defied the conventional method of breaking horses and developed his own gentler approach — based on horses' non-verbal language. Roberts spoke with Fresh Air in 1997.
item.content:encoded: The internationally acclaimed horseman defied the conventional method of breaking horses and developed his own gentler approach — based on horses' non-verbal language. Roberts spoke with Fresh Air in 1997.

item.title: Senate passes Russia sanctions bill that was long championed by Lindsey Graham
item.description: The bill is meant to stifle Russia's economy by allowing for tough new tariffs against major importers of Russian energy. The legislation was led by Lindsey Graham before his unexpected death in July.

item.title: Blanche's path to confirmation appears clear after winning key Republican's support
item.description: A key Republican senator, Bill Cassidy of Louisiana, said he would back Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, smoothing the path for his ultimate confirmation by the Senate.

item.title: Employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs in a sign of a wilting labor market
item.description: U.S. employers cut 23,000 jobs in July, and job gains for the two previous months were weaker than initially reported, according to a report Friday from the Labor Department.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: A new vaccine could vanquish a major cause of deadly diarrheal disease
item.description: Over 1 million people a year die from diarrheal disease. Nearly half are kids under age 5. A new vaccine in trials offers great hope.

item.title: Everyone's talking about hormone therapy for menopause. Should I be on it?
item.description: For years, doctors advised against hormone therapy for women in the menopausal transition. Now everyone's talking about how great it is. Is it really a wonder drug that women should all be on?
